jobs.prompt: Original instrumental competitive strategy game music for Gauntlet's Play screen. Moderate-to-fast tempo, 132-148 BPM, tense and energetic without becoming exhausting. Cinematic percussion, driving low strings, sharp brass accents, subtle futuristic synth pulses, occasional choir-like textures used only as instruments, and a memorable tactical motif. Structure it as a full three-minute match arc: confident opening, escalating midgame, brief strategic breath, then a decisive high-energy finale. No vocals, no lyrics, no imitation of any existing game soundtrack. Polished, heroic, mysterious, suitable under card-game sound effects and dialogue.
